reviews.text:
Always pleasant, fast, and reasonably priced.
I recommend it.
One of the best grooming salons in the Chartreux area, the lady is always so friendly, I highly recommend it! Don't change a thing, everything is perfect 👍🏼 …

I wanted to thank this pet grooming service for their warm welcome and for taking the time to help me. 🤝 Unfortunately, they didn't offer any wet pet food. However, they kindly gave me an address where I could find some. 🙏🏻🐶 …

I have a rather large and timid dog with black claws, and she's the only person who agrees to take care of him and does it well, truly looking after the animal. She's a wonderful woman with a lot of respect.

The lady is very kind.
My little dog looked beautiful, and the price was very reasonable.
I recommend her.
Top-notch groomer, the owner always gives a warm welcome and her prices are very affordable. I highly recommend her.

Very happy after Toffy's grooming.

I highly recommend it.

A fantastic groomer for us, the four-legged companions of those humans who, despite their love for us, can't afford to take us for grooming every three months! I, a little Shih Tzu who loves my human in return, never leave Nathalie's hands traumatized thanks to her gentleness and professionalism. I highly recommend you go and get pampered!
Thank you.
